A CHOOSER DECLARED extern IN THE SITE'S FILE AND DEFINED EXACTLY ONCE IN THE TEMPLATE SET RESOLVES AT THAT DEFINITION, rule named "[extern, defined once in the set]"; defined twice it stays UNRESOLVED (the census does not guess). bb_call.cpp:363 and :413 call bb_callee_baked_sym(_bk), declared extern there and defined in bb_call_fn.cpp:39, so unresolved 2 -> 0 and unpolled 3 -> 5: both resolve to rt_call_callee_sn4/rt_call_fld_sn4 and read UNPOLLED with a COMMON-TAIL nomination, the same shape as bb_call_fn.cpp:180 and :245 (the emitted code polls after the whole if/else chain on the success path and skips the poll on the DT_FAIL path, exactly as the chain's other arms do). The baseline counts are NOT raised: the five are a standing red introduced by 06438a341 and de0302f83 (bake layers 7 and 9, 2026-09-29) and stay red until cured or ruled. Selftest 69 -> 71 arms (both directions planted).

# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-23 cto, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1224, row spine-no-rtccb-veneer-on-any-call-into-the-asm-runtime-the-rtx-abi-preserves-r8-to-r11): safe-points. A CONDITIONAL TAIL EXIT IS A CALL-GRAPH EDGE, AND SO IS A TRANSFER THROUGH A GOT SLOT. The 09-18 cure made `jmp` an edge and left `je/jne/...` out, so every asm entry whose only road to its allocating C twin was a conditional exit read NON-ALLOCATING -- VARVAL_fn, rt_size_d, rt_str_coerce, rt_match_enter, rt_defer_close, table_find_pair_d, rt_cap_open -- and 67 functions with them (the checked-in allocating table 1698 -> 1765, none removed). allocating_call_sites 230 -> 236, polled 230 -> 232, unpolled 0 -> 4, identity 232 + 0 + 4 == 236, MEASURED ON THE PARENT TREE 8a2e9bdff (its own binary, this census) BEFORE the row that surfaced it, so the rise is the instrument getting honest about a standing tree, not a landing going backwards (the CEO-1119 shape; the ratchet refuses a rise, so the baseline is raised here). THE FOUR, EACH A ROW: bb_match_begin.cpp rt_match_enter, bb_match_defer.cpp and bb_match_value.cpp rt_defer_close, bb_unop.cpp rt_size_d -- allocating calls with no safe point after them. The same row made emitted code call the asm runtime bare and turned every such exit into a CALL from a local stub, which is how the gap surfaced, and it added calls and tail jumps THROUGH THE GOT (RTX_CALL / RTX_JMP), which objdump labels with the nearest symbol rather than the target: the walk resolves the slot through its GLOB_DAT relocation and skips PLT stubs. Selftest 65 -> 69 arms (a conditional exit, a GOT slot to the allocator and one to a stranger, a GOT call with no map, a PLT stub).

# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-22 coo, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1147, row instruments-the-safe-point-census-reader-...): safe-points. FOUR READER DEFECTS, AND THEY CANCELLED ON THE HEADLINE WHILE FOUR INDIVIDUAL SITES WERE WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. polled 190 -> 190, partially_polled 0 -> 6, unpolled 63 -> 57, identity 190 + 6 + 57 == 253. (a) MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE STATEMENT ARMS: emit.cpp's icn_trace_tap and xa_flat.cpp's xa_icn_trace_tap are an if/else-if/else chain of allocating hook calls followed by ONE poll; the base predicate read each arm's SUCCESSOR ARM as a later call and stopped the window, so six sites read UNPOLLED. _stmt_sibling_offsets is the statement-level twin of _ternary_sibling_offsets, which COO-146 named and did not mechanize. (b) THE CONDITIONAL SKIP, THE ONLY SPECIES THAT MADE THE NUMBER TOO BIG (ceo, CEO-1132): the guard's `je` is emitted ABOVE the call and its landing pad BELOW the poll, so a reader looking only BETWEEN them sees nothing and credits a poll that is stepped over whenever g_trace == 0 -- which is every program that never assigns &trace. Two sites were credited that way; they are PARTIAL now, not polled. (c) THE GUARD IS ITSELF CONDITIONAL: IF(kind == 2 || kind == 3 || kind == 5, ... je) in emit.cpp and IF(kind != 1, ...) in xa_flat.cpp are NOT emitted on the kind == 1 arm, whose poll is unconditional. Reading (b) without (c) would have condemned two sound arms. (d) A SIBLING ARM IS NOT A GUARD: _poll_is_guarded matched `else if (kind == 2)` with its plain `if (` test and called xa_flat.cpp:427 PARTIAL although its poll is unconditional -- the same alternatives-as-sequence confusion at a FOURTH level. ⭐ MEASURED FROM EMITTED BYTES BEFORE A LINE OF THE READER WAS WRITTEN, and the reader then reproduced the predicted 190/6/57 independently: `./scrip --compile` on a two-procedure Icon witness shows each kind 2/3 tap as cmp/je -> hook -> rt_gc_poll_asm -> landing pad (lines 131/142/149/153), and each kind 1 tap as hook -> rt_gc_poll_asm with no branch at all. `long g_trace = 0` is src/runtime/keywords.c:17. ⛔ partially_polled IS NOW RATCHETED. It was printed, demanded zero by the census header, and watched by NOTHING; six sites could have become sixty with every gate green. ⛔ AND THE CENSUS NOW REFUSES rc=2 ON A STALE BUILD (ceo CEO-1147 calls this the sharpest of the four): census_safe_points derives its DENOMINATOR from out/libscrip_rt.so via allocating_entries_from_binary, so an unbuilt tree does not merely date the verdict, it changes WHICH CALLS ARE COUNTED. Witnessed both ways at the landing. lib_build_currency.sh is SOURCED, never reimplemented, and there is deliberately no escape hatch.

# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-22 coo, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1119, on the coo's measured delta): safe-points. A POLL THAT FOLLOWS A LATER CALL IS THAT CALL'S SAFE POINT. The base predicate's poll window now stops at the first intervening emitted call, the stop the expansion-site window has carried since CEO-1116 -- the SAME defect one level up, held back at COO-142 because it moves the published headline and that is the ceo's call. polled 156 -> 149, unpolled 97 -> 104 on SCRIP 20424784f. ⭐ THE RISE IS THE INSTRUMENT GETTING HONEST, NOT THE TREE GETTING WORSE (ceo, CEO-1119, the CEO-935 shape): the ratchet REFUSES a rise by design, so the baseline is raised in this same landing. This SUPERSEDES the ceo's NEXT MOVE note carried below, which forecast this change -- it is history now, not a forecast. ⛔ THE MECHANICAL ARM ALONE READS 148, NOT 149, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE WHOLE POINT: a mechanical stop can NOMINATE a site and cannot CONVICT one (the symmetric half of the ceo's own law that a static reader can reject a site and cannot clear one). Sixteen first nominations, nine thrown away by hand, seven published. The ninth rejection -- bb_call_value.cpp:130, where the intervening call at :134 sits inside the ELSE arm opened at :131 -- was named at COO-143 as an unmechanized blind spot rather than rounded away, and THIS landing mechanizes it: _ternary_sibling_offsets tracks an ARM INDEX PER PAREN DEPTH, so a line in a different arm of a ternary the site also stands in is an ALTERNATIVE, never a successor. It replaces the leading-character exemption entirely -- one rule, not two -- and reproduces the hand-read name set of 104 EXACTLY, name for name, not merely the count. ⛔ TWO EARLIER SHAPES OF THAT RULE WERE WRONG AND BOTH WERE CAUGHT BY MEASURING AGAINST THE HAND-READ NAMES RATHER THAN AGAINST A COUNT: a line-granular reader re-nominated the five sites whose '?' is on their own line (bb_iterate.cpp:27/:28/:29, bb_field_get.cpp:21/:39), and a latching one CLEARED THREE the hand read convicted (bb_match_capture.cpp:124/:163, bb_rev_assign_var.cpp:19) because it read the arm the site LIVES IN as an arm the site is excluded from. Five planted selftest arms hold both directions, each proven able to go red (selftest 47 -> 52 arms). SCRIP_GC_CENSUS_BASE_CALL_STOP=0 reproduces the pre-CEO-1119 reading and was verified byte-identical on all 97 names.

# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-22 coo, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1109, the cto's finding): safe-points. ONE SOURCE CALL LINE IS NOT ONE EMITTED PATH. The predicate reads SOURCE PROXIMITY while POLLED is a claim about EMITTED CONTROL FLOW, and the emitter concatenates strings, so a call written once inside a file-local helper or a #define is spliced into every path that expands that unit. TWO NEW COLUMNS, multi_path_sites and partially_polled, and partially_polled is NOT counted in polled. ⛔ THE HEADLINE DOES NOT MOVE ON THIS TREE -- 152 of 253 before and after, partially_polled=0 -- so this is the instrument gaining a verdict it did not have, not a landing and not a regression. WHAT MOVES IS WHAT IT CAN SEE: 58 of the 253 sites are multi-path and were previously graded by a window that cannot distinguish one path from four. MEASURED PROOF THAT THE EXPOSURE WAS REAL, not argued: a poll planted under IF(g_gva_active) in bb_assign_global's comm_var tap reaches TWO of its FOUR expansions, and the old criterion read it polled=153 unpolled=100 and dropped the site from the worklist; the new one reads it PARTIAL and leaves polled at 152. ⛔ THE PATH COUNT IS AN UPPER BOUND AND SAYS SO: emit.cpp's icn_trace_tap expands at six sites but its call lines sit in mutually exclusive caller-selected arms, so the kind==2 call at :2914 is reached by one of the six. ⛔ AND ONE STOP RULE IS LOAD-BEARING, caught by reading the output rather than by writing the rule: an expansion-site window stops at the first intervening emitted call, because without it the reader credited NV_SET_fn's x86_rt_gc_poll_rec_res() to the comm_var tap spliced in above it and reported 2 of 4 paths polling on a tap the cto had deliberately left unpolled.

# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-17 cto, SCRIP 5dd2d79f0, recorded here by the coo: COVERAGE. Every words_scanned / interior_words reading taken BEFORE that tree was taken through a blindfold and none of them bounds anything: the conservative sniff gc_zeta_frame started at the address of a char local, three bytes off a word boundary, so it found ZERO arena-pointing words on the main stack -- measured 0 unaligned against 3, 7, 11, 12 aligned over the same four collections. # CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-17 coo, SCRIP this landing: CALLBACKS, ON CEO-836's WORD THAT THE NUMBER IS NOW LOAD-BEARING. The 63 was wrong three ways and the third is the one that mattered. (i) THE SCOPE WAS TWO HAND-NAMED FILES AND ONE OF THEM HOLDS NO SITE: gen_runtime.c contributes zero, so the census read ONE file while naming two, and FIVE real sites of the identical class stood outside any denominator, in pattern_match.c, rt/rt.c and core/core.c. The scope is now DERIVED by walking src/runtime and src/driver -- 86 files. (ii) A DECLARATION IS NOT A CALL SITE: the filter tested the line's TERMINATOR, so a prototype ending ';' and a one-line definition ending '}' both counted -- FIFTEEN of the 63 were declarations, including five of the rt_call_arr_* forwarders at by_name_dispatch.c:5167-5171. The test is now the declarator prefix BEFORE the name, with the C keywords that may precede a call excluded. (iii) THE CRASH THE NUMBER IS SUPPOSED TO BOUND WAS NOT IN IT: the regex matched calls TO the dispatcher and never the callback OUT of it, so by_name_dispatch.c:5260 `out = APPLY_fn(fn, args, nargs);` -- the exact gdb site CEO-836 traced, the raw heap name pointer live across a call into emitted code -- was outside the census entirely. OUTBOUND is now its own printed population over a DECLARED set (APPLY_fn, _usercall_hook, rt_chain_enter, rt_chain_enter_v) that REFUSES rc=2 if a named symbol leaves the tree. (iv) RT_GC_CALLBACK IS DEFINED NOWHERE IN src/: wrapped=0 was never 'nobody has wrapped one yet', and a no-op macro would have taken this census to GREEN with no semantic change -- the definition's absence is now PRINTED beside the count. THE ARITHMETIC CLOSES: 63 -> 48 on the same two files once a declaration stopped counting (-15), -> 53 when the scope was derived (+5 real sites the old scope never opened), and a SECOND key beside it, callbacks.unwrapped_outbound = 13, which is where by_name_dispatch.c:5260 finally appears. THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT GETTING HONEST, NOT A LANDING GOING BACKWARDS -- one tree, one sitting, no cure landed and none claimed.

# CRITERION UNCHANGED, COUNT EARNED 2026-09-22 coo, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1124 chunk C, the FINAL four; the chunk is 21 of 21 and the amendment now expires by its own terms): safe-points.unpolled 73 -> 69, polled 180 -> 184, partially_polled 0 and the identity holding (184 + 0 + 69 == 253). ⛔ RE-MEASURED AFTER THE REBASE AND NOT COMPUTED, per the chunk's condition FOUR: this row was first proven 76 -> 72 on the pre-revert tree, then SCRIP 58820a280 (concat-slot revert) and 7a1361373 (bb_goto_deferred revert) landed under it and took the base to 73, so BOTH arms were rebuilt on the rebased tree and re-read to 180 and 184. The delta is a difference between two readings of one tree, never arithmetic over an older base. ⭐ THE FOUR ARE NOT ONE FORM, WHICH IS WHY THEY WERE SPLIT OUT OF THE 17 RATHER THAN FORCED: bb_define 314 and 327 rt_ab_leave_env take x86_rt_gc_poll_res because rt.h:84 declares the callee DESCR_t, so the returned pair IS the canonical tagged cell (descr.h:64 -- tag plus slen in word 0, pointer in word 1) that poll_res's two raw stores reconstruct; and because x86_align_enter/x86_align_leave are BOTH EMPTY STRINGS at these two, there is no envelope to root it and the value is live only in rax:rdx before the store to AB_OFF_RES0/RES1. bb_define 433 rt_define_site (void) and 945 rt_proc_call_open_slim (plain long) take a BARE poll placed BEFORE x86_scan_sync_in_rr, because scan_sync_in_rr reloads r14 from rt_scan_sync_in and a poll after it would leave r14 holding a pre-move scan pointer; 945's rax survives its test rax,rax because rt_gc_poll_asm touches only r10/r11 on the fast path and rt_gc_poll_slow restores rax raw. THE DISCRIMINATOR, agreed with the cto and the cfo this tick: poll_res is sound exactly where the callee's DECLARED RETURN TYPE is DESCR_t, checkable from the C signature without reading an instruction. ⛔⭐⭐ AND THE COO-145 MECHANISM SENTENCE IN THE ENTRY BELOW IS RETRACTED, BY THIS SEAT, AGAINST ITSELF: "the poll inside the envelope roots the caller's rax:rdx for free because they are still pushed" IS WRONG, and so is the clause above it calling the sweep CONSERVATIVE. The range walk does NOT root conservatively -- gc_walk_words counts a raw heap word above the floor and LEAVES IT ALONE, and the only relocation is gc_cell_visit, which validates a TAG WORD against the known DT set. push rax then push rdx puts the POINTER at the LOWER address and lays the pair down BACKWARDS, so gc_cell_visit rejects it. ABOVE THE FLOOR IS NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT (the cto's correction, checked against the source rather than conceded). ⛔⭐⭐ THE SECOND RETRACTION IS WORSE AND IS ALSO THIS SEAT'S: the entry below calls the 6-site trace-tap gap a FALSE NEGATIVE, "the safe direction, which convicts a cured site rather than clearing an uncured one". IT CLEARS AN UNCURED ONE. The shared poll sits INSIDE the g_trace guard and the emitted skip target is defined AFTER it -- cmp rax,0 / je .L / hook call / call rt_gc_poll_asm / .L: -- with g_trace = 0 at src/runtime/keywords.c:17 unless a program assigns ampersand-trace, so the poll is DEAD CODE by default at every kind 2, 3 and 5 tap; and the reader CREDITS kind 3 (rt_trace_fail_hook, the last call in the chain) as POLLED. A credited site whose poll is jumped over is a FALSE POSITIVE in the number reported to Lon. COO-145 cited "the guard skip label AFTER the poll" as PROOF the sites were polled; the same fact proves the poll is BYPASSED. Ruled at CEO-1132 (close chunk C on the four, carry the six as a named reader defect) and CEO-1133 two (the bar measures PRESENCE, NOT CORRECTNESS). The reader row is the instruments officer's on return. ⭐ EVIDENCE, AND THE WORD CLEARED IS DELIBERATELY NOT USED (the cto's withdrawal under CEO-1133: for a coverage cure the clean-tree control IS the no-cure arm, so identical name sets prove NO REGRESSION and never a cure): 435 SNOBOL4 entries selected from ALL.csv by the DEFINE feature column (375 rich + 60 sampled control), extracted standalone with zero refusals, two arms back to back in one window as two real libscrip_rt.so copies selected by LD_LIBRARY_PATH, stress 0 and 5 under SCRIP_GC_RELOC=1, SCRIP_HEAP_KB=128 and setarch -R at a 30 s ceiling: stress 0 reads 15 non-green on EACH arm, stress 5 reads 33 on EACH arm, BOTH DIFFS EMPTY, identical name sets in both directions, 1740 cells. ⭐ GRADED THE INSTRUMENT BEFORE THE TREE: these four change the SNOBOL4 DEFINE path only -- on an Icon procedure witness the two arms are BYTE-IDENTICAL at 1024 lines and 11 polls -- so an Icon population would be a vacuous green and was not run to pad the receipt. ⭐ STEP 3 RE-RUN AGAINST THE CURED SCREEN at the cto's explicit ask, and the re-run was necessary: the old reader was VERDICTLESS below its floor and returned before its findings block, so the 88 percent refusal recorded at COO-145 could have been hiding findings. The cured reader NAMES 4 POINTER findings and they are IDENTICAL ON BOTH ARMS -- same names, same sites 464/621/770/888, same r13 subject-base dereference in hb_scan_subject_across_allocating_poll.icn, same 89 percent decided. This landing adds ZERO new findings; those four are the scan spine and are the cto's lane. ⛔ preflight 59 arms, 1 RED -- test_gate_c_allocators_are_eradicated_and_say_where_they_went.sh, rc=1 on BOTH arms, INHERITED and not this landing's.

# CRITERION UNCHANGED, COUNT EARNED 2026-09-22 cto, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1124, chunk A sub-batch 2 of the standing chop): safe-points.unpolled 82 -> 76, polled 171 -> 177, partially_polled 0 and the identity holding (177 + 0 + 76 == 253). THE SIX rt_scan_needle SITES in bb_scan_any:35, bb_scan_bal:42, bb_scan_find:31 and :48, bb_scan_many:38 and bb_scan_upto:38, all ONE form: a NEW two-cell tagged poll x86_rt_gc_poll_rec_sigma_needle, cell 0 {DT_S, r15d, r13} for the subject base and cell 1 {DT_S, edx, rax} for the needle. ⛔⭐ THE BASE WAS MEASURED ON THIS TREE AND NOT COMPUTED, per the chunk's condition FOUR: the clean tree was read at polled=171 unpolled=82 with the cure stashed, so the fall of exactly six is a delta between two readings of one tree and not arithmetic over the coo's 84 or the cfo's 82. ⛔ THE FORM IS NOT poll_res AND NOT A BARE POLL, and the reason is mechanical rather than stylistic: rt_scan_needle returns ScanSubjRegs {ptr, len}, so rax is the POINTER and rdx a LENGTH, the MIRROR IMAGE of the canonical DESCR_t rax:rdx return where rax is the tag word. poll_res writes rax at offset 0 and rdx at offset 8 with no tag, which reconstructs a well-formed cell ONLY for the DESCR_t convention; at a {ptr, len} return it puts a pointer where the tag belongs, gc_cell_visit rejects it and the needle is rooted by nothing. The discriminator, agreed with the coo this tick: poll_res is sound exactly where the callee's DECLARED RETURN TYPE is DESCR_t, and that is checkable from the C signature without reading an instruction. ⭐ AND THE WALK IS NOT CONSERVATIVE, which is what makes the tag load-bearing: gc_walk_words COUNTS a raw heap word above the floor into s_raw_heap and REPORTS it through gc_walk_site, and never calls rt_gc_visit_raw on that path. The only relocation in the range walk is gc_cell_visit, which validates the tag against the known DT set and the pointer against its block. Above the floor is NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT. ⛔⭐⭐ A BARE POLL AT THESE SIX SITES IS NOT INERT AND IT IS NOT A GC DEFECT: four arms as four libscrip_rt.so copies selected by LD_LIBRARY_PATH, instrument graded first by reading each arm's emitted form at the site, on a nine-line witness whose answer is 3000 -- two-cell 3000, poll_res 3000, clean 3000, BARE POLL 0, exit code 0 and silent, at stress 1/3/5 and at 128 KB. AT A 512 MB ARENA WITH SCRIP_GC_EXERCISE=1 REPORTING collections=0 ON BOTH ARMS THE BARE POLL STILL ANSWERS 0 AND THE TWO-CELL FORM STILL ANSWERS 3000, so the collector never ran and the defect is in the EMISSION. NAMED, NOT CURED, and scoped to these six sites only. The reusable instrument is the zero-collection arm: run the suspect form at an arena large enough that collections=0, and if it still fails it is not a GC defect at all. ⭐ SCREEN: util_gc_poll_register_liveness.py REFUSES(2) at 88% decided against its own 95% floor on BOTH arms and cleared nothing -- recorded as a refusal with an UNCHANGED reject population (POINTER r12=19 r13=4, all others 0, identical either side) across safe_points 3321 -> 3325, never as a pass. NO SHARED NODE TOUCHED, measured not assumed: 7 SNOBOL4, Prolog, Raku and Pascal programs compile BYTE-IDENTICAL across the cure and clean arms, so no SNOBOL4 board is owed.

# CRITERION UNCHANGED, COUNT EARNED 2026-09-22 coo, SCRIP this landing (CEO-1124, chunk C of the standing chop): safe-points.unpolled 95 -> 84, polled 158 -> 169, partially_polled 0 on both arms and the identity holding. ⛔ RE-MEASURED AFTER THE REBASE AND NOT COMPUTED, because the baton's condition FOUR says a baseline proven before a rebase is void: this row was first proven as 104 -> 93 against SCRIP fa1dc84a5, then 07f0ab2ba (+3 Icon range-generator sites) and d9a11dd63 (chunk A sub-batch 1, +6 scan-spine sites) landed under it and took the base to 95, and the rebased tree was rebuilt and re-read to 84. The 11 sites this landing credits are the same 11 either way, but the number was taken from the instrument on the rebased tree rather than by arithmetic on the old one.
